items.title: GameStop (GME) Rethinks $56 Billion Bid And Pitches Partnership Instead
items.summary: GameStop (NYSE:GME) CEO Ryan Cohen is reconsidering the company's proposed US$56b takeover offer for eBay and is now exploring alternative structures. Cohen is said to favor a joint venture or partnership that would use GameStop's physical retail network to support eBay's platform. The revised approach could include GameStop seeking board seats at eBay instead of pursuing a full acquisition. items.summary: GameStop, led by Chief Executive Officer Ryan Cohen, is considering withdrawing its $56 billion bid for eBay Inc., according to people familiar with the matter.
